steps: A turning operation is performed on a CNC Turning Center for 17 minutes at a spindle speed of 1200 rpm, with a tool offset of 0.02 mm and CNC program T01, Z0.5, R0.1, starting with a raw metal bar on a conveyor belt and producing a finished lathed part on a conveyor belt.

Surface Grinding is performed on a Grinding Machines for 25 minutes using an Aluminum oxide grinding wheel at 3000 rpm with a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, transforming a Planed part from a MobileRobot into a Ground part that is then conveyed to a ConveyorBelt.

A lathe turning operation is performed on a Horizontal Lathe for 65 minutes using a high-speed steel tool at a rotation speed of 800 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, transforming a Metal bar from the ConveyorBelt into a Lathed part that is then transferred to a MobileRobot.

A tapered broach is used on a Broaching Machine to broach a Metal bar on a ConveyorBelt for 31 minutes at a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev and a depth of cut of 5 mm, resulting in a BroachedComponent being conveyed on the ConveyorBelt.

A spur gear with 24 teeth is shaped on a Gear Shaper for 80 minutes at a shaping speed of 80 rpm, starting from a broached component held by a mobile robot and ending as a shaped gear conveyed to the conveyor belt.

The cylinder honing operation is performed on a Honing Machine for 64 minutes using a 60-grit honing tool to finish a honed cylinder with a bore size of 50 mm, taking 120 seconds per cycle, resulting in a precision finished part that is transferred to a mobile robot.
A metal bar is band sawed on a Bandsaw for 30 minutes at 1500 rpm using a carbide blade with a 10 mm cutting width to produce a lathed part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

A precision milling operation is performed on a Stewart Platform Mill for 36 minutes using a 3-axis tool set with a milling precision of ±0.01 mm and an active vibration damping system, transforming a milled part on a conveyor belt into a ground part that is then transferred to a mobile robot.

A Vertical Milling Machine mills a lathed part for 99 minutes at a speed of 1000 rpm using an end mill with a depth of cut of 3 mm, transforming the lathed part into a milled part that is then transferred to a mobile robot.

Final Milling is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 16 minutes using a contour tool path at a milling speed of 1200 rpm to achieve a surface finish of Ra 1.6 μm, starting with a milled part carried by a mobile robot and ending with a finished machined component transferred to a conveyor belt.

A gear hobbing operation is performed on a Hobbing Machine for 32 minutes at a hobbing speed of 60 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev using a standard involute gear profile, starting with a broached component on a ConveyorBelt and producing a hobbied gear that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A drilling operation is performed on a metal bar using a drill press for 3 minutes at a spindle speed of 1500 rpm, a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, and a drill size of 6 mm, resulting in a drilled component that is transferred to a mobile robot.

Wire EDM Cutting is performed on a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) for 28 minutes using a molybdenum wire with a cutting speed of 0.05 mm/s, peak current of 20A, and pulse duration of 50ns, transforming a shaped part on a conveyor belt into a precision finished ground part delivered to a mobile robot.

The shaping operation is performed on a Shaper for 79 minutes using a form tool with a stroke length of 150 mm and a shaping speed of 40 mm/min, starting with a milled part held by a mobile robot and ending with a shaped part transferred to a conveyor belt.

A planing operation is performed on a Planer for 1 minutes to reduce the surface of a Milled part by 0.5 mm with a feed rate of 0.3 mm/min, achieving a surface finish of Ra 3.2 μm, resulting in a Planed part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A Vertical Lathe Turning operation is performed for 50 minutes on a Metal bar input component, using a Carbide tool with a rotation speed of 900 rpm and a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, resulting in a Lathed part output component that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

The laser cutting operation is performed on a Laser Cutter for 94 minutes using a laser power of 1500 W, a cutting speed of 5 mm/s, and nitrogen gas assist, transforming a sheet metal component on a conveyor belt into a cut sheet metal product that is then transferred to a mobile robot.

Shearing the sheet metal on the Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 31 minutes at a shear angle of 45 degrees, cutting speed of 8 m/min, using a high-carbon steel blade, starting from sheet metal on the ConveyorBelt and producing sheared sheet metal on the MobileRobot.

Punching is performed on a Punch Press for 87 minutes using a 10 mm punch size, with a stroke speed of 100 mm/s and die alignment within ±0.05 mm, starting with sheet metal on a conveyor belt and ending with a finished sheet metal product on the conveyor belt.
On the Screw Machines, a lathed part is screwed with an M6 coarse thread screw for 94 minutes to produce a screwed component, which is then transferred to the conveyor belt.

A shaping operation is performed on a Shaper for 71 minutes using a high-speed carbide tool with a stroke length of 300 mm and a shaping speed of 80 mm/min, starting with a milled part on the ConveyorBelt and producing a shaped part on the ConveyorBelt.

A broached component is hobbed on a Hobbing Machine for 86 minutes at a hobbing speed of 150 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev to produce a 20° full depth involute gear, with the input component transferred from the MobileRobot to the ConveyorBelt as a finished HobbiedGear.

A wire EDM cutting operation is performed on a shaped part conveyed on a conveyor belt using a tungsten wire with electrical parameters of 15 A, 50 V, and 200 microseconds pulse duration at a cutting speed of 10 mm/min, for 16 minutes, to produce a precision finished part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

A Bandsaw Cutting operation is performed for 79 minutes on a MetalBar component conveyed on a ConveyorBelt, using a high-tensile carbide blade at 1200 rpm with a cutting width of 20 mm, resulting in a LathedPart that is then conveyed on the ConveyorBelt.

A spur gear with 24 teeth is shaped on a Gear Shaper for 92 minutes at a shaping speed of 60 mm/min, starting from a broached component held by a MobileRobot and ending as a shaped gear delivered to a ConveyorBelt.

Sheet metal punching is performed on a Punch Press for 51 minutes, using a 15 mm punch size, a stroke speed of 80 mm/s, and automatic die alignment with 0.02 mm tolerance, starting with sheet metal on a ConveyorBelt and producing a finished cut sheet metal product on the same ConveyorBelt.

The shaping operation is performed on a shaper for 14 minutes using a flat end tool with high wear resistance, with a stroke length of 100 mm and a shaping speed of 5 mm/min, starting with a milled part on a conveyor belt and producing a shaped part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

A spur gear with 24 teeth is shaped on a Gear Shaper for 64 minutes at a shaping speed of 120 rpm, starting from a broached component on the ConveyorBelt and producing a shaped gear on the ConveyorBelt.

A Bandsaw performs Band Saw Cutting on a Metal bar component delivered via ConveyorBelt, cutting it to a width of 50 mm using a cobalt-coated blade at a saw speed of 3000 rpm, for 10 minutes, and outputs a Lathed part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

Sheet metal shearing is performed on the Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 95 minutes to cut sheet metal into sheared sheet metal, using a high-carbon steel blade with coolant spray at a shear angle of 45 degrees and a cutting speed of 12 m/min, with the input sheet metal fed on the conveyor belt and the output sheared sheet metal conveyed out on the same conveyor belt.

Surface Grinding is performed on a Grinding Machines using an Aluminum oxide wheel at 3000 rpm with a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, processing a Planed part transported by a MobileRobot for 7 minutes to produce a Ground part that is then conveyed to the ConveyorBelt.

A turning operation is performed on a Horizontal Lathe for 38 minutes using a Carbide turning tool at a rotation speed of 600 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, converting a Metal bar from the ConveyorBelt into a Lathed part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A planing operation is performed on a Planer for 11 minutes to remove material from a Milled part on a ConveyorBelt, achieving a planing depth of 3 mm, a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, and a surface finish of Ra 1.6 µm, resulting in a Planed part being transferred to a MobileRobot.

Final Milling is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 35 minutes using a contour cutting tool path with 5-axis interpolation at a milling speed of 1000 rpm to achieve a surface finish of Ra 0.8 µm, starting with a milled part on the ConveyorBelt and ending with a finished machined component also on the ConveyorBelt.

The CNC Turning and Finishing operation is performed on a CNC Turning Center for 25 minutes using a preloaded program P001 with a tool offset of 0.05 mm set for both X and Y axes, at a spindle speed of 1200 rpm, starting with a lathed part on a MobileRobot and ending with a finished machined component as a MilledPart on a ConveyorBelt.

The laser cutting operation is performed on a Laser Cutter for 77 minutes using a laser power of 2 kW, a cutting speed of 15 mm/s, and nitrogen assist at 10 bar, transforming a sheet metal component on the conveyor belt into a cut sheet metal product also on the conveyor belt.

A vertical turning operation is performed on a Vertical Lathe for 82 minutes using a high-speed steel tool at a rotation speed of 750 rpm and a feed rate of 0.18 mm/rev, converting a Metal bar from the ConveyorBelt into a Lathed part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A broaching operation is performed on a Broaching Machine for 79 minutes to create an internal keyway using a tapered broach, with a feed rate of 0.5 mm/rev and a depth of cut of 10 mm, starting with a Metal bar on a ConveyorBelt and producing a Broached component on the same ConveyorBelt.

On the Screw Machines, a Screw Thread Machining operation is performed for 81 minutes to screw thread an M8 metric coarse thread onto a lathed part, converting it into a screwed component that is then transferred to the conveyor belt.

A gear hobbing operation is performed on a Hobbing Machine for 17 minutes at a hobbing speed of 80 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev using a standard involute profile, transforming a broached component on a ConveyorBelt into a hobbied gear that is then transferred to a MobileRobot.

The cylinder honing operation is performed on a Honing Machine for 33 minutes using a honing grit size of 60, with a bore size of 50 mm and a cycle time of 120 seconds, starting with a Honed cylinder on the ConveyorBelt and producing a Precision finished part on the ConveyorBelt.
